name: LQS - Brief: generate and deliver
description: In: conversation_id, booking_id. Out: { ok, brief_id, delivered_to }. Six fixed blocks; blocks 1, 4, 5 and 6 are assembled by code from database rows only, blocks 2 and 3 go through one LLM call with a raw-value fallback. Delivers to Telegram, email and the calendar event.

parameters.query: select c.id as conversation_id, c.channel as channel, c.language as language, c.status as conversation_status, c.escalation_reason as escalation_reason, c.questions_asked as questions_asked, l.id as lead_id, l.full_name as lead_name, l.email as lead_email, l.phone as lead_phone, l.timezone as lead_tz, l.status as lead_status, m.timezone as market_tz, m.currency as currency, a.id as agent_id, a.full_name as agent_name, a.email as agent_email, a.telegram_chat_id as agent_chat_id, a.calendar_id as calendar_id, coalesce(a.timezone, m.timezone) as agent_tz, (select row_to_json(bb) from (select bk.id, bk.starts_at, bk.ends_at, bk.status, bk.calendar_event_id from lqs.bookings bk where bk.conversation_id = c.id and (nullif($2, '') is null or bk.id = nullif($2, '')::uuid) order by bk.created_at desc limit 1) bb) as booking, (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('slot_key', q.slot_key, 'value', q.value, 'state', q.state, 'attempts', q.attempts, 'previous_values', q.previous_values) order by sd.priority), '[]'::json) from lqs.qualification q join lqs.slot_definitions sd on sd.slot_key = q.slot_key and sd.market_id = c.market_id and sd.deal_type = c.deal_type where q.conversation_id = c.id) as qualification, (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('slot_key', sd.slot_key, 'question_open', sd.question_open, 'tier', sd.tier, 'required', sd.required) order by sd.priority), '[]'::json) from lqs.slot_definitions sd where sd.market_id = c.market_id and sd.deal_type = c.deal_type and sd.active) as slot_definitions, (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('direction', mm.direction, 'body', mm.body, 'created_at', mm.created_at) order by mm.created_at), '[]'::json) from lqs.messages mm where mm.conversation_id = c.id) as transcript, (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name)), '[]'::json) from lqs.projects p where p.market_id = c.market_id and p.active) as projects from lqs.conversations c join lqs.leads l on l.id = c.lead_id join lqs.markets m on m.id = c.market_id cross join lateral (select ag.* from lqs.agents ag where ag.active and ag.market_id = c.market_id order by ag.created_at limit 1) a where c.id = $1::uuid;

messageValues.message:
You write two short pieces of an internal briefing note for a real-estate agent about to take a call. The agent has thirty seconds to read it.

summary: one sentence naming who this lead is and what they want, built only from the values on file. Never invent a fact. Never name a project, a price or a date that is not in the data.

watch_out: one or two short sentences on what could go wrong on this call. Draw only on: conflicting answers, exit strategy, who else is in the decision, slots the lead dodged, and any escalation reason. If there is genuinely nothing to flag, write exactly: Nothing unusual.

Plain English. No headings, no bullets, no markdown, no greetings. Never address the lead. Never give advice about what to sell.

parameters.query: insert into lqs.briefs (conversation_id, booking_id, content_markdown, content_blocks, delivered_to) values ($1::uuid, nullif($2, '')::uuid, $3, $4::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) returning id as brief_id;
update lqs.briefs set delivered_to = $2::jsonb where id = $1::uuid returning id as brief_id, delivered_to;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Insert Brief').item.json.brief_id, JSON.stringify({ telegram: $('Send Brief To Agent Telegram').item.json.error ? 'failed' : 'sent', email: $('Send Brief To Agent Email').item.json.error ? 'failed' : 'sent', calendar: $json.error ? 'failed' : 'sent' })] }}
